nodes.summary: Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Drop D tuning with a capo, showing tuning and capo info in the score header. Extracted from a Guitar Pro 7.6 save; contains only the score.xml content.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A dense lick with several musical effects on neighbouring notes displayed in lanes above the tablature, testing how Guitar Pro 7.6 writes combined effects.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Four voices on one staff - voices 1 and 3 with stems up, voices 2 and 4 with stems down, with whole-bar rests hidden. Tests multi-voice notation rendering.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A full header with title, subtitle, artist, album, words, music, copyright, tabber, and tuning fields. Tests header and metadata serialization.

Guitar Pro file created by Mateus in Guitar Pro 7.6: nylon guitar with both high E strings played open. Used to verify Guitar Pro's octave numbering (MIDI note ÷ 12) and how default tunings are written.
Guitar Pro file created by Mateus in Guitar Pro 7.6: six piano tracks with notes spanning MIDI 0 to 127. Used to verify Guitar Pro's handling of out-of-range frets and default tuning assignment.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Repeat signs, a repeat played three times, first and second endings, and a double bar. Tests repeat and ending notation serialization.

Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Rehearsal letters with section names; segno and coda signs at bar starts, with To Coda, Fine and D.S. al Coda directions. Tests section markers and navigation directions.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A labelled starting tempo followed by tempo changes at bar boundaries and mid-bar. Tests tempo marking serialization at different granularities.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Quintuplets, sextuplets, septuplets, duplets, and a 5:3 ratio marked with n:m notation. Tests non-standard tuplet serialization.

Documentation explaining the guitar-pro-check fixture directory: files for checking the .gp and .gp5 writers, including test results from Guitar Pro 7.6.0 on Wine/Debian. Documents known interop issues and how to regenerate files.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests accents, heavy accents and staccato markings on both standard notation and tablature staves. Used to verify OxiGuitar's .gp writer handles articulation symbols.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same articulations test as articulations.gp but in .gp5 binary format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for articulation symbols.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests a four-string bass with bass clef an octave down over a four-line tablature. Used to verify OxiGuitar's bass guitar track writing.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same bass test as bass.gp in .gp5 binary format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for bass guitar tracks.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests beaming over groups of eighth and sixteenth notes, single-note flags, and mixed beam groups. Used to verify OxiGuitar's beam and flag serialization.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same beams-and-flags test as beams-and-flags.gp in .gp5 format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for beam and flag notation.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests text annotations placed above beats, next to chord names and tempo markings. Used to verify OxiGuitar's beat-level text serialization.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same beat-text test as beat-text.gp in .gp5 format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for beat-level text annotations.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests full, half and released bends with their arrow indicators and labels. Used to verify OxiGuitar's bend effect serialization.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same bends test as bends.gp in .gp5 format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for bend effects.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests chord names placed over their beats without being pushed sideways, along with chord diagrams in the score header. Used to verify OxiGuitar's chord name serialization.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same chord-names test as chord-names.gp in .gp5 format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for chord name placement.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp file: Tests chords with sharps, flats and naturals in C key, with accidentals carried through the bar. Used to verify OxiGuitar's chord and accidental serialization.
Guitar Pro 5 .gp5 file: Same chords-and-accidentals test as chords-and-accidentals.gp in .gp5 format. Used to compare .gp vs .gp5 writer output for chord and accidental notation.
